orders_money_nonneg.name: orders_money_nonneg
orders_money_nonneg.value: subtotal_cents >= 0 AND discount_cents >= 0 AND tax_cents >= 0 AND delivery_fee_cents >= 0 AND tip_cents >= 0 AND total_cents >= 0

orders_schedule_consistent.name: orders_schedule_consistent
orders_schedule_consistent.value: (schedule_type = 'scheduled' AND scheduled_for IS NOT NULL) OR (schedule_type = 'asap' AND scheduled_for IS NULL)

orders_delivery_has_address.name: orders_delivery_has_address
orders_delivery_has_address.value: fulfilment <> 'delivery' OR address_json IS NOT NULL

products_flags.name: products_flags
products_flags.value:
taxable IN (0, 1) AND pickup_eligible IN (0, 1) AND delivery_eligible IN (0, 1)
          AND halal_capable IN (0, 1) AND promotion_eligible IN (0, 1) AND active IN (0, 1)
          AND sold_out IN (0, 1) AND setup_required IN (0, 1)

promotions_limits.name: promotions_limits
promotions_limits.value: (usage_limit IS NULL OR usage_limit > 0) AND (per_customer_limit IS NULL OR per_customer_limit > 0)

promotions_window.name: promotions_window
promotions_window.value: starts_at IS NULL OR ends_at IS NULL OR ends_at > starts_at

promotions_flags.name: promotions_flags
promotions_flags.value: combinable IN (0, 1) AND exclusive IN (0, 1) AND active IN (0, 1)

timesheet_amounts_nonneg.name: timesheet_amounts_nonneg
timesheet_amounts_nonneg.value: paid_ms >= 0 AND regular_ms >= 0 AND overtime_ms >= 0 AND gross_pay_cents >= 0

toppings_flags.name: toppings_flags
toppings_flags.value: is_meat IN (0, 1) AND has_halal_version IN (0, 1) AND halal_available IN (0, 1) AND active IN (0, 1)
